claims: Chime is currently experiencing a widespread verified outage as of April 1, 2026.
Thousands of users reported issues accessing the mobile app.
Thousands of users reported issues checking balances.
Thousands of users reported issues using features like SpotMe and transfers.
Over 16,000 reports were made at the peak of the outage.
The mobile app is primarily affected (roughly 80% of issues).
Chime’s official status tracker has acknowledged the incident.
Chime’s official status tracker is working on a fix.
Chime has indicated that user money and personal information are secure despite the disruption.
Chime is investigating a platform-wide service disruption.
